lines.title: Understanding the organization and its context
lines.testFocus: External and internal issues relevant to information security are identified and kept current.

lines.title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
lines.testFocus: Interested parties and their information security requirements, including legal and regulatory, are identified.

lines.title: Determining the scope of the ISMS
lines.testFocus: Scope is documented, boundaries and interfaces are justified, and it matches what is actually operated.

lines.title: Information security management system
lines.testFocus: The ISMS and its processes are established, implemented, maintained and continually improved.

lines.title: Leadership and commitment
lines.testFocus: Top management demonstrates commitment - resources, direction, integration into business processes.

lines.title: Policy
lines.testFocus: An information security policy exists, is appropriate, communicated and available to interested parties.

lines.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
lines.testFocus: Security roles are assigned, communicated and understood by the people holding them.

lines.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities - general
lines.testFocus: Risks and opportunities to the ISMS achieving its outcomes are determined and planned for.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Statement of Applicability

lines.title: Information security risk assessment
lines.testFocus: A defined, repeatable risk assessment process with criteria for acceptance and for performing assessment.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Statement of Applicability

lines.title: Information security risk treatment
lines.testFocus: Treatment options selected, controls determined, Statement of Applicability produced, owners accept residual risk.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Statement of Applicability

lines.title: Information security objectives and planning to achieve them
lines.testFocus: Objectives are measurable, monitored, communicated and supported by plans with resources and dates.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Statement of Applicability

lines.title: Planning of changes
lines.testFocus: Changes to the ISMS are carried out in a planned manner.
lines.evidenceLives: IS Risk Register · Statement of Applicability

lines.title: Resources
lines.testFocus: Resources needed for the ISMS are determined and provided.

lines.title: Competence
lines.testFocus: Competence requirements are defined, met, and evidence of competence is retained.

lines.title: Awareness
lines.testFocus: Staff are aware of the policy, their contribution, and the consequences of not conforming.

lines.title: Communication
lines.testFocus: Internal and external security communications are defined - what, when, with whom, by whom.

lines.title: Documented information - general
lines.testFocus: The ISMS includes the documented information required by the standard and that needed for effectiveness.

lines.title: Creating and updating documented information
lines.testFocus: Identification, format and review/approval of documents is controlled.

lines.title: Control of documented information
lines.testFocus: Availability, protection, distribution, version control, retention and disposal are controlled.

lines.title: Operational planning and control
lines.testFocus: Processes are planned, implemented and controlled; outsourced processes are controlled.

lines.title: Information security risk assessment (performance)
lines.testFocus: Risk assessments are performed at planned intervals and when significant change occurs; results retained.

lines.title: Information security risk treatment (performance)
lines.testFocus: The risk treatment plan is implemented and results are retained.

lines.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
lines.testFocus: What is measured, by what method, when, by whom, and how results are evaluated.

lines.title: Internal audit - general
lines.testFocus: Internal audits are conducted at planned intervals against the standard and the department's own requirements.

lines.title: Internal audit programme
lines.testFocus: Programme covers frequency, methods, responsibilities, reporting; auditors are objective and impartial.

lines.title: Management review - general
lines.testFocus: Top management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals.

lines.title: Management review inputs
lines.testFocus: All required inputs are present, including audit results, risk status and interested party feedback.

lines.title: Management review results
lines.testFocus: Decisions on improvement and change are recorded and acted on.

lines.title: Continual improvement
lines.testFocus: The suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the ISMS is continually improved.

lines.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
lines.testFocus: Nonconformities are reacted to, root cause established, action taken and effectiveness reviewed; records kept.
